slices.focus: Three straight quarters under denial target and shorter payment lag prove the turnaround is sustained, not luck.
slices.summary: Kelli can now document three straight quarters with first-pass denials under target and materially shorter payment lag. The network is calmer — far less month-end panic across clinics. She frames the sustained turnaround as the result of 'repeatable operating habits, not luck' and plans a one-page maintenance sheet (core metrics, owners, escalation thresholds). She feels protective of the process rather than territorial, and states her role has shifted from emergency responder to system operator.
